Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jan 01, 2015 - Oct 31, 2016

description.narrative:
Action 1: 1. The government enacted the Republic Act No. 10691 to mandate the institutionalization of PESOs in all strategic cities and municipalities (local government units), set minimum standards for PESO operations and staff complements, and secure national and local government budgetary funding for Peso's operations and programs. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 2: 2. The government through the General Appropriations Act allocated P95 million for PESO capacity development in 2015 and 2016. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 3: 3. Capacity development plan for PESOs endorsed by DOLE and implementation commenced in 2016. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 4: 4. The government (through DOLE) commenced implementation of its enhanced national Labor Market Information System starting with an upgraded national skills registry and enhanced job portal PhilJobNet. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 5: 5. The government institutionalized the JobStart Philippines (JSP) youth employment program through enacting the JSP Bill securing national government budget funding, and DOLE through Department Order No. 148-16 established the national JSP Unit with designated staff and budget of P106 million to oversee JSP implementation. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 6: 6. The government (through DOLE) commenced the nationwide rollout of JSP starting with 14 local government units in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, 59% of JSP participants are women. Target date: 2016-10-31
Action 7: 7. The government strengthened the Special Program for Employment of Students (SPES) by enacting the RA No. 10917 to provide for a government funded wage subsidy to poor students based on the financial capacity of each LGU, and the 2015 and 2016 GAA allocated P1.4 billion for funding the SPES program. Target date: 2016-10-31

title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 2 Implementation Period: Apr 01, 2019 - Apr 30, 2021

description.narrative:
Policy 1: Reform Area 1: Improved public employment facilitation services NA
Action 2: 2. To further improve the operation of the PESO network, DOLE: (i) implemented Training Regulations for PESO managers to address gender issues in the workplace, and (ii) received approval from TESDA and commenced the development of the competency standards for PESO staff. with a completion date expected by the end of 2021. Target date: 2021-04-30
Action 3: 3. To increase the technical capacity of PESOs, DOLE: (i) increased the number of PESOs using PEIS to 1,607; (ii) integrated new sex-disaggregated data fields related to OFWs into PEIS; (iii) launched a digital chatbot to remotely register jobseekers' information into the PEIS; and (iv) implemented the DOLE Establishment Report System to use sex disaggregated job loss data to provide benefits to affected workers during the pandemic under the COVID-19 AMP. Target date: 2021-04-30
Action 4: 4. To reduce the administrative costs of employment for first-time jobseekers, Congress enacted the First-Time Jobseekers Act and DOLE issued the implementing rules and regulations: (i) requiring national government agencies and LGUs to waive fees and charges for more than 10 pre-employment documents; (ii) instructing PESOs to act as one-stop-shops to help first time jobseekers secure pre-employment documents; and (iii) establishing an interagency monitoring committee to monitor the compliance of the concerned government agencies. Target date: 2021-04-30
Action 5: 5. To enhance the implementation and outreach of JSP during the pandemic, 61% of participating LGUs provided counterpart funding to JSP; and DOLE: (i) developed a digital LST program with modules covering digital literacy, mental health, sexual and reproductive health and rights, women's' empowerment, and work ethic; (ii) established a pool of 209 qualified PESO staff who are now delivering the LST; and (iii) increased the number of companies participating in JSP by 75, to 292, with partner employers representing key employment generating sectors such as food and accommodation, tourism, manufacturing, trades. and construction. Target date: 2021-04-30
Action 6: 6. To improve temporary employment opportunities for poor but deserving students and out-of-school youth, DOLE enhanced implementation of the SPES program by: (i) issuing guidelines to implement SPES in areas under the community quarantine to promote working from home arrangements for students; and (ii) upgrading the program's quality management system by requiring all DOLE Regional Offices to use the Quarterly Work and Financial Report in line with the ISO 9001:2015 when submitting quarterly SPES accomplishments. Target date: 2021-04-30
Action 1: 1. Target date: 2016-10-31
